findings.location: End of manuscript, under the heading 'Tables' (after References)
findings.rule: Figures and Tables should be embedded in the template file at the appropriate locations (Section 5(1) Text).
findings.problem: Both Table 1 and Table 2 are collected at the end of the manuscript under a separate 'Tables' heading rather than being embedded at the locations in the text where they are first cited (Table 1 in the 'Network construction' paragraph; Table 2 in the 'Nucleotide-dependent potential' paragraph).

findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends.
findings.problem: Eight of the twelve listed references ([3], [5], [6], [7], [9], [10], [11], [12]) are never cited anywhere in the text, tables, or figure legends. Only [1], [2], [4], and [8] appear in the body. Consequently the numbering is not sequential by order of first appearance (the text jumps from [2] to [4] to [8]).
